svg.aria-label: A dark surveillance record, set in monospace, headed ROLLING RECORD SEP 2025 - SEP 2026. Three large figures across the top: 27 pull requests, 20 merged, 9 repositories they went to. Beneath it, PATROL LOG, a column chart of 13 months of pull request activity running SEP to SEP along a rail of month names. Each column's height is the pull requests opened that month, with the merged share bright at its foot and the rest a dimmer step above; 6 of the 13 draw no column at all and what is drawn stands almost entirely in the last three. The busiest, JUL 2026, carries the chart's only warm mark, a thin red cap, with its count of 11 printed above. Below, SIX HEAVIEST NIGHTS: 6 horizontal bars in date order from 21 SEP to 23 AUG, each with its date at the left and its event count at the right, running 46 to 88. The heaviest, 88 on 23 AUG, is marked PEAK and carries a small red wedge at its tip. A pale hairline stands through all six at a typical night of 14 events, so the longest bar reads as about 6 ordinary nights end to end. A very faint city skyline stands along the bottom edge.
svg.title: Night Watch · what the rolling year of activity was made of
